data.desc: Rantizo (NASDAQ: RNTZ), headquartered in Houston, Texas, develops drone-based technologies and services designed to address operational challenges across agriculture, forestry, emergency response, infrastructure and commercial markets. Through its expanding portfolio of unmanned aircraft systems, Rantizo is focused on advancing drone technology, supporting domestic manufacturing capabilities and delivering innovative aerial solutions for applications where efficiency, accessibility and operational performance are critical.
